budget.title: Full-Day Szentendre History Tour + Local Budget Food
budget.summary: A full historical journey through Szentendre’s churches, museums, and heritage sites — paired with affordable local meals.

schedule.title: Fő Tér Historical Warm-Up
schedule.description: Start at the main square, the historic heart of Szentendre — surrounded by old merchant houses and centuries-old architecture.

schedule.title: Serbian Orthodox Cathedral Area
schedule.description: Walk up to the historic Serbian Orthodox church, symbol of the Serbian settlers who shaped Szentendre’s culture.

schedule.title: Szentendre Church Trail
schedule.description: Check out several historic churches — Baroque, Orthodox, and Catholic — each showing a different layer of local history.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a traditional Hungarian or Serbian-influenced meal — soups, stews, or daily menus at a friendly price.

schedule.title: Szentendre Historical Museum
schedule.description: Visit the town museum to see artifacts, local traditions, and stories from Szentendre’s multi-ethnic past.

schedule.title: Blagovestenska Church & Baroque Streets
schedule.description: Walk around Baroque-era merchant streets and explore one of Szentendre’s most beautiful Orthodox church courtyards.

schedule.title: Danube Promenade & Simple Drink
schedule.description: End the day with a peaceful walk along the Danube and a drink in a budget-friendly riverside café.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Szentendre History Journey with Comfortable Dining

schedule.title: Coffee & Fő Tér Introduction
schedule.description: Enjoy a morning coffee on the main square while taking in the traditional architecture and early-morning atmosphere.

schedule.title: Historic Churches of Szentendre
schedule.description: Visit two or three iconic churches representing different cultural groups — Serbian, Hungarian, Greek, and Catholic influences.

schedule.title: Old Town Heritage Walk
schedule.description: Explore narrow streets filled with stories of merchants, settlers, and artisans who shaped the town centuries ago.

schedule.title: Traditional Comfortable Lunch
schedule.description: Sit down for a hearty Hungarian lunch — soups, slow-cooked dishes, or stuffed specialties in a cozy restaurant.

schedule.title: Szentendre Historical Museum
schedule.description: Learn about the town’s multicultural past, Serbian immigration, arts heritage, and rural traditions.

schedule.title: Skansen Preview (Optional Exterior Walk)
schedule.description: Walk near the surrounding area of the Open-Air Museum and learn about rural Hungarian architectural heritage.

schedule.title: Riverside Evening Finish
schedule.description: Return to the center and enjoy a peaceful riverside moment — maybe with a glass of wine or a light snack.
